vulnerability.name: WebDAV Upload to CGI Code Execution
vulnerability.author: Tom Shaw
vulnerability.description: Turns an unauthenticated, writable Apache WebDAV collection into remote code execution by enabling CGI for everything under the WebDAV docroot. Enables mod_cgi and drops a config snippet that adds Options +ExecCGI and a cgi-script handler for /var/www/webdav, so an executable script dropped into the collection runs instead of being served as text. An attacker who can PUT to the collection uploads a CGI shell (a .cgi/.pl/.sh with the exec bit) and runs commands as the Apache user. This is the execution half of the chain: it pairs with apache_webdav_upload (the writable collection) to give a shell.
vulnerability.hint: The WebDAV collection now runs CGI: PUT an executable .cgi/.pl script and request it over GET to execute commands as www-data.
